name: Hoshi no Ne Sanctuary
original_name: 星ノ音サンクチュアリ
source:
Even in a world where science has vastly progressed, people still wish upon shooting stars. Masato was in danger of dropping out of school, but his wish may have come true. Intra-class and intra-year teams were created for a special exam and if he makes it out on top, then he would be able to stay in the school. Moreover, his teammates were all beautiful girls.

However, all of them have personalities which make them unsuited to teamwork. Hisui doesn’t like interacting with others, Yomi has a sharp tongue, while Ria is a hopeless brother complex. He even has the milady Serina proclaiming herself as his rival. Even though great difficulties lie ahead of him, he vows not to give up. It is up to him to make this peculiar team work as one!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
即使在科学高度发达的世界，人们仍然会向流星许愿。真人面临退学危机，但他的愿望或许已经实现了。

为了参加一场特殊考试，学校组建了跨班级、跨年级的队伍。如果他能取得第一名，就可以继续留在学校。而且，他的队友全都是漂亮女孩。

然而，她们的性格都不适合团队合作。翡翠不喜欢与人交往，夜美说话尖刻，而莉亚则有着无可救药的兄控情结。甚至还有自称他竞争对手的大小姐瑟莉娜。

尽管前方困难重重，真人仍发誓绝不放弃。让这支奇怪的队伍团结一心，就靠他了！

[来自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
